description: Return the persisted markers + AI analysis (Summary, KeyFindings, Recommendations, DetailedExplanation) for a specific medical-test the authenticated patient owns. Use after mediora__get_patient_history surfaces a test id the user wants to discuss. Bearer token must be a Mediora patient-scope JWT. Proxies https://api.mediora.ai/api/medical-tests/{id} with the user's token forwarded as Authorization: Bearer.

test_id.description: Numeric medical-test id (returned by mediora__get_patient_history as `id`).
